sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
A small pinwheel made of red and white paper. Found about halfway up Mount Kongo.
The red and white pinwheels simply spin round and round.
Everyone is right here.
Found opposite of the Armoured Warrior fight, on the edge of a cliff.
Can be given to Kotaro near the Senpou Temple Idol, although he will say it is not the right flower, he will thank Wolf for his efforts. Unlocks the possibility to send Kotaro to the Abandoned Dungeon to fulfill the surgeon's request for a strong man, or to be sent to Anayama the Peddler after he requests Wolf to help him with "expanding his business". The latter unlocks the Promissory Note.
